bolt.move.title: Move the nuts
bolt.move.body: Tap a bolt to lift its top nuts, then tap another bolt to slide them over. Nuts stack on an empty bolt or on a nut of the same color. Give every color a bolt of its own.

twist.capped.title: Short bolts
twist.capped.body: Bolts with an orange end cap are shorter and hold fewer nuts. They make a handy parking spot, but they can never hold a full color.

twist.rusty.title: Rusty nuts
twist.rusty.body: A rusty nut is stuck fast. Its little tag shows which color to finish first. Once that color sits together on one bolt, the rust lets go.
